description: This file contains a set of tests for the Playwright testing framework, specifically testing the 'reporter-line' reporter's output and behavior under various conditions such as retries, flaky tests, output formatting, error handling, and debugging pauses.

methods.name: render unexpected after retry
methods.description: Tests the output rendering for a test that fails and is retried multiple times.

methods.name: render flaky
methods.description: Tests the output indicating a flaky test based on retry info.

methods.name: should print flaky failures
methods.description: Verifies that flaky failures are correctly printed and counted.

methods.name: should work on CI
methods.description: Ensures output correctness and failure reporting when running in CI environment.

methods.name: should print output
methods.description: Checks that console output during a test is correctly captured and printed.

methods.name: should trim multiline step titles to first line
methods.description: Validates that multiline step titles get truncated to their first line in report.

methods.name: should render failed test steps
methods.description: Tests rendering of nested test steps that fail.

methods.name: should not render more than one failed test steps in header
methods.description: Checks that only one failed step is summarized in the header.

methods.name: should not render more than one failed test steps in header (2)
methods.description: Summary of previous test, verifying no duplicate failure summaries.

methods.name: should show error context with relative path
methods.description: Verifies that error context paths are correctly displayed relative to project roots.

methods.name: should not include global tag in the title
methods.description: Ensures tags like '@global' do not appear in test titles in the output.

methods.name: pause at end
methods.description: Tests pausing at test end with console output and proper handling of interruption.

methods.name: pause at end - error in teardown
methods.description: Verifies proper reporting when teardown hooks throw errors during pause.

methods.name: pause on error
methods.description: Tests that the debugger pauses on test errors with proper output.
